title: C-TEC XFP 16 / 32 zone

coverage.strategy: Deterministic projection of every reviewed engine source node, preserving source edition, access, reference status and explicit navigation bindings.
mappedAreas: All 62 reviewed source nodes, including documented access level 3 options.
Reference-only, PC, hardware and unsupported operations remain visibly distinct from supported simulation.
10 authored practice tasks, separate from the manufacturer menu tree.
excludedAreas: Source manuals establish documented controls, not hardware-certified firmware timing. Page 19 describes zones-in-test at level 3 and page 18 mentions level-2 functions, but their positions are absent from the page-17 level-3 tree. The trainer preserves that tree and accesses those functions through the documented level-2 tree instead of inventing their level-3 positions.
Cause/effect, zone/device labels, dependency settings and I/O output-set assignment require XFP507 PC programming; no panel-only substitute is invented.
Calibration, intensive monitor, loop-poll results, EEPROM, network events and printer hardware remain source references.
NVM unlock and access level 3 are separate. Relock memory before leaving installer access.
The selected cabinet has its own saved configuration and capacity bounds. CAST, Hochiki and repeaters are not silently substituted.
Fictional sounder mapping is one-out/all-out to group 1; it is not a real installation cause/effect matrix.
coverage.confidence: Manufacturer-manual-backed reference and fictional practice. No hardware or firmware certification.
